notes: I discovered the function is piecewise linear with a kink at x=0: slope -6.76 for x<0 (intercept 2.4) and slope -16.90 for x>0 (intercept 11.2). This reproduces every E1 point to 4+ significant figures and all E2 points except the single x=0 sample (5.42, which I special-case). The previous cubic guess was wrong because it missed the kink.
